subject: 明代北方府城：北方合院（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated reusable building sprite for tianshu default building-map, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city (Beijing/Datong/Xian regional vocabulary), anonymous original period-inspired design, not a measured heritage reconstruction. Input image is STYLE reference only: match its restrained realistic material detail, fine grey clay roof tiles, weathered masonry and natural matte wood, and same detail density. Change architecture to Ming north as specified. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric ground projection, camera yaw45 elevation30, east axis down-right slope +0.5 and north up-right slope -0.5; parallel ground edges, vertical posts, no perspective convergence. South entrance on screen lower-left edge. Complete building on thin rectangular ground-contact footprint with readable left, front, right corners, footprint axis ratio as specified, no thick pedestal, no soil island. Neutral soft light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow only toward lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background and generous blank alpha0 margins all four sides; no skyline, no surrounding scenery. No people, writing, Chinese pseudo-glyphs, text, plaques, signs, banners, watermark, grid, modern fittings, plastic render, cartoon, ink wash, oversaturation, dense lanterns, white halo or baked checkerboard. Only building and its own footprint; include all eaves and base corners uncropped. Asset ID bld_kit_ming_north_courtyard. Footprint 10 metres east-west by 8 metres north-south. A modest enclosed northern courtyard home, grey-brick perimeter walls, THREE low hard-gabled grey-tile wings facing a quiet bare brick/earth courtyard, simple dark timber lattice doors, plain small gate offset on south wall; muted worn plaster, no ornamental moon gate, no plants or elaborate carving. Correction of the first candidate: all three wings and gate must have NORTH CHINESE YINGSHAN hard-gabled roofs, flush tall grey-brick triangular gable walls rising to ridge at both ends, NO overhanging eaves at gable ends and NO upward-curled corner tips. Preserve matte weathered material. Ground long front edge rises only 0.5 pixels per horizontal pixel; depth edge descends only 0.5; strict 2:1 ground diamond, footprint10x8. Absolutely transparent clean outside, not a vignette. No added plants.
